'''Kamile Noallin''' is a banker in [[Chachin]]. 

==Appearance==
Mistress Noallin is a slim and lovely woman. She is in her middle years. Her hair is graying and worn in four long braids.

==Activities==
In {{ne|979}} she had a reputation for reliability and honesty. [[Moiraine Damodred]] used her services to gain the funds needed to enter [[Kandor]]i society and investigate the [[Aesdaishar Palace]] during her search for the [[Dragon Reborn]]. Noallin's place of work was a small, fortified building well inside the city walls.
